# Copilot instructions

The project's agent instructions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. They are the single source of truth for every coding agent (Claude Code, Cline, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, Codex, Cursor). Read and follow that file. Don't duplicate its content here.

Shared skills live in [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/), each as `<name>/SKILL.md`. `.claude/skills` is a symlink to the same folder.
